title.zh: 将南甘马粦省戈阿市镇皮纳格拉巴南描笼涯的Pinaglabanan中学更名为Pinaglabanan国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Pinaglabanan High School in Barangay Pinaglabanan, Municipality of Goa, Province of Camarines Sur to Pinaglabanan National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Pinaglabanan High School in Barangay Pinaglabanan, Municipality of Goa, Province of Camarines Sur to Pinaglabanan National High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11762_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Pinaglabanan High School in Barangay Pinaglabanan, Municipality of Goa, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby changed to Pinaglabanan National High School.
The main campus of the Pinaglabanan National High School shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Pinaglabanan, Municipality of Goa, Province of Camarines Sur.
This Act shall become effective fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
